verdict.rationale: Klaviyo's pricing docs confirm a drag-and-drop email editor and basic email templates, and its AI Composer can draft content, which covers the visual-editor and template parts of the story. The evidence does not mention personalization tokens or cross-client rendering, so only about half the story is supported. Missing for 10: personalization/merge-tag token documentation, cross-client rendering or preview/testing evidence, brand-kit or on-brand styling controls, and independent hands-on corroboration.
